findings.fix: Run `git diff --name-only -z <base>` and `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z` and split on NUL instead of strings.Fields, so paths with spaces or non-ASCII bytes come back verbatim.
findings.claim: GitChangedFiles tokenizes `git diff --name-only` / `git ls-files --others` output with strings.Fields and without -z, so a changed declaration file whose path contains a space (split into fragments) or a non-ASCII byte (core.quotePath=true emits it C-quoted, e.g. "rules/pr\303\274fung.acdsl") never reaches ruleDelta under its real name: os.ReadFile of the fragment/quoted name fails and is silently skipped (policy.go:248), GitShowFile reports it absent (any ExitError = absent, git.go:94-96), so the file contributes no rules on either side. In gated/strict mode a branch can add, modify or remove protected-scope rules in such a file and CheckPolicy reports nothing — item correctness-74 (rule delta over every changed declaration file) fails for that input class.
findings.evidence: Re-read internal/acdsl/git.go:46-66 (GitChangedFiles: plain --name-only, strings.Fields at 57), internal/acdsl/policy.go:237-280 (ruleDelta: workLines only filled when ReadFile succeeds, base side via GitShowFile which maps every ExitError to exists=false), and rule.go:97-106 (declarationMarker accepts .acdsl plus every syntax-table class, so e.g. `docs/my rules.acdsl` or a German-named `.acdsl`/`.go` file is a declaration file). Sequence: gated repo, agent branch adds `//acdsl:RULE-PLAN-001 ...` (PLAN not in editable_scopes) to untracked `acdsl/team rules.acdsl` → ls-files prints `acdsl/team rules.acdsl` → Fields yields `acdsl/team` and `rules.acdsl` → ReadFile(root/rules.acdsl) fails or reads an unrelated file, ReadFile(root/acdsl/team) fails → the added rule is absent from workRules → no policy diagnostic. Not a variant of the known rename-detection finding (different mechanism: tokenization/quoting, not --find-renames).
